name: Warhammer
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Warhammer: martial melee; damage 1d8 bludgeoning; properties versatile; mastery push. Exact range/Versatile, weight and cost are normalized from the p.91 row in definition. Complete property/mastery rules on pp.89–90 apply.

authored_operations: Resolve actual proficient attack ability, same ability for Finesse attack/damage, range, hands and declared properties before paying/rolling. Thrown uses its melee ability where applicable and draws as part of attack; Reach adds 5 feet for attacks and Opportunity Attacks.

Loading fires at most one piece per action, Bonus Action or Reaction regardless of attack count. Ammunition spends one actual typed piece per attack, requires free loading hand for one-handed weapons, and recovers floor(half spent) after one minute following a fight.

Heavy checks Strength 13 for melee or Dexterity 13 for ranged; enforce normal/long range. Lance is Two-Handed unless mounted. Light/Nick use one extra different-Light-weapon attack and omit positive ability damage; apply only an unlocked mastery with the exact source trigger, target, duration and cap.

definition.name: Warhammer
definition.description: A heavy hammer usable in one or two hands.
